description: This file defines the Configuration class for managing dual-stack endpoint settings within the AWS SDK for PHP, including validation and conversion methods.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Handles configuration related to use of dual-stack endpoints in AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the configuration with specified dual-stack usage and region, validating the inputs.

methods.name: isUseDualstackEndpoint
methods.description: Returns whether dual-stack endpoint usage is enabled.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
